node.title: Re^2: delete folder and its content with plain perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The error probably has to do with the use of forward slashes in the filename, which appear to be interpreted as switches by rmdir.

I strongly recommend you use remove_tree from [doc://File::Path], as several others have suggested. It has been a core module for over 20 years and should therefore not only meet your requirement of being "plain Perl", but unlike rmdir it is also platform-independent!

Also, note that you probably don't want to use a "delete directory" function to delete individual files. See [doc://unlink] for files.
